text.en: Dog owners report that their pets receive top-quality attention throughout short stays and extended boarding bookings up to sixteen nights. Clients note that dogs return home calm, well exercised, and in excellent physical condition. Reviewers express peace of mind knowing that the facility treats their pets with consistent care and dedicated personal supervision.

Pet parents highlight dependable boarding outcomes, noting dogs come home happy, sleepy, and in top form after their stays. Reviewers particularly praise the facility's quick and decisive action during an unexpected medical illness, promptly coordinating with the owner's vet to safeguard the pet's health. Clients feel completely confident leaving animals for long holidays.

Reviewers warmly praise operators Alan and Brendagh for their genuine passion, friendliness, and high standard of personal responsibility. Clients appreciate that the owners keep pets safe and handle unforeseen medical situations calmly while owners are travelling abroad. Returning families frequently recommend the kennels for trustworthy and loving boarding care.

q.en: How does West City Kennels handle pet health emergencies?

a.en: Reviewers report that when a boarded pet became unwell, the owners took immediate action, transporting the pet directly to their vet.

q.en: Can dogs stay for extended boarding periods?

a.en: Yes, clients report smooth and problem-free boarding stays for dogs lasting over two weeks.

q.en: Are both dogs and cats accommodated at the property?

a.en: Yes, the facility operates insulated indoor-outdoor dog kennels alongside a purpose-built indoor cattery.

q.en: Do pets receive daily outdoor exercise?

a.en: Dogs staying at the kennels are exercised twice daily in a dedicated outdoor grass paddock.
